from object_parser import belongs, is_nobits


def align(value, alignment):
    return (value + alignment - 1) // alignment * alignment


class OutputSection:
    def __init__(self, name, segment):
        self.name = name
        self.segment = segment
        self.nobits = is_nobits(name)
        self.sections = []
        self.base_components = []
        self.components = []
        self.address = 0
        self.size = 0
        self.alignment = 1


class Segment:
    def __init__(self, name, base, length, fill, output_names):
        self.name = name
        self.base = base
        self.length = length
        self.fill = fill
        self.outputs = [OutputSection(output, self) for output in output_names]
        self.paddr = base
        self.filesz = 0
        self.memsz = 0
        self.used = 0
        self.image = bytearray()


def find_output(section_name, outputs):
    return next((output for output in outputs if belongs(section_name, output.name)), None)


def assign_segment(segment):
    cursor = segment.base
    segment.filesz = 0
    for output in segment.outputs:
        output.alignment = max((component.alignment for component in output.components), default=1)
        cursor = align(cursor, output.alignment)
        output.address = cursor
        for component in output.components:
            cursor = align(cursor, component.alignment)
            component.address = cursor
            cursor += component.size
        output.size = cursor - output.address
        if not output.nobits:
            segment.filesz = cursor - segment.base
    segment.memsz = cursor - segment.base

class Resolution:
    def __init__(self, name, entries, script=False):
        self.name = name
        self.entries = entries
        self.strong = [entry for entry in entries if entry.kind == "defined" and entry.binding == "global"]
        self.weak = [entry for entry in entries if entry.kind == "defined" and entry.binding == "weak"]
        self.commons = [entry for entry in entries if entry.kind == "common"]
        self.references = [entry for entry in entries if entry.kind == "undefined"]
        self.referrers = list(dict.fromkeys(entry.owner.name for entry in self.references))
        self.strong_definers = (["*script*"] if script else []) + [entry.owner.name for entry in self.strong]
        self.definition = None
        self.size = 0
        self.alignment = 1
        self.address = None
        self.live = False
        self.unresolved_referrers = []
        if script:
            self.kind = "script"
            self.definer = "*script*"
        elif self.strong:
            self.kind = "global"
            self.definition = self.strong[0]
            self.definer = self.definition.owner.name
        elif self.commons:
            self.kind = "common"
            self.size = max(entry.size for entry in self.commons)
            self.alignment = max(entry.alignment for entry in self.commons)
            self.definer = next(entry.owner.name for entry in self.commons if entry.size == self.size)
        elif self.weak:
            self.kind = "weak"
            self.definition = self.weak[0]
            self.definer = self.definition.owner.name
        elif any(entry.binding == "global" for entry in self.references):
            self.kind = "undefined"
            self.definer = "-"
        else:
            self.kind = "weakundef"
            self.definer = "-"


def resolve_names(entries, script_names):
    names = sorted(set(entries) | set(script_names))
    return {name: Resolution(name, entries.get(name, []), name in script_names) for name in names}
